description: This simulator does not know that parameter, and the LRM (§9.18) makes an unknown name with no default an error rather than a guess. Answering it with a plausible number would be worse: a simulation parameter is a promise about the solver's behaviour, and this engine would not keep one it never implemented.
actions: Supply a fallback: `$simparam("{name}", <value>)` is valid and returns it.
Or query one of the names this engine does know: {known}.
